docs.summary: A compact toolbar of square icon buttons (Nebula .ftool / .ftb): the active button is accent-filled with a soft glow, others show a hover state. Lays out horizontally or vertically and can wrap itself in its own glass container. Build via [`IconToolbar`](#api~Prowl.OrigamiUI.Origami~IconToolbar), add buttons with [`Item`](#api~Prowl.OrigamiUI.IconToolbarBuilder~Item), then call [`Show`](#api~Prowl.OrigamiUI.IconToolbarBuilder~Show).

members.name: Item
members.signature: public IconToolbarBuilder Item(IOrigamiIcon icon, string? tooltip = null)

docs.summary: Append a button with a vector icon and optional hover tooltip.
Stack the buttons vertically (e.g. a left rail) instead of a horizontal row.
Wrap the buttons in a glass container with a soft border (default true).
Center the toolbar horizontally within the available width (horizontal layout only).
